main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (3-bar forward return minus coin mean), mean_reversion grid bars
main_measure.threshold: t >= +2 confirms (with supporting check), t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean product top third of |forecast| minus bottom third

decided_by: The main measure's t is at least +2 and the top-minus-bottom third check is above 0.
reading: The coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over all grid bars of all its windows, the grid bars whose 3-bar forward return leaves the window are dropped, the thirds are the N//3 smallest and N//3 largest |forecast| cases after a stable sort, and the 100-case minimum is applied as 'not observable'.
